clause: The transform group is normative and its members are:
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: The transform group is normative and its members are:** anchor point, position (with separated X, Y and Z sub-streams observable in the recovered documents), scale, rotation about Z, rotation about X, rotation about Y, orientation (3D), and opacity. Rotation properties are UNWRAPPED: they accumulate past 360 degrees and store full revolutions plus a residual angle, so a keyframe pair from 350 to 370 degrees animates 20 degrees forward rather than 330 backward. This is not a display convention; it is a storage requirement, and collapsing rotation into a 0..360 range destroys animation.
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
